evidence.quote: Language requirements: All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
The tuition fee is 7,500 USD / year for this program.
The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform

notes: The quoted fee is in USD, not EUR or HUF; it is the fee the programme's own page states for this programme. An institution-wide tuition table also lists Mechanical Engineering * 7 semesters 7,500 USD/year. The application deadline '15th June' carries no year, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline; the page also says the programme starts in September of each year. The entrance exam requirement is recorded as a manual_check because the pages do not state numeric grade thresholds.
